metadata.title: Agent CLI Reference & Binary Cross-Check Matrix
metadata.description: Cross-verification of CLI flags between public documentation (cloudphone-official:agent-deploy.md) and static binary symbols in cloudphone-agent

flags.documentation_role: Unique device identifier assigned to the cloudphone instance (e.g. vm-01)
flags.binary_context: Found in cloudphone-agent .rodata alongside CP_AGENT_ID environment fallback
Found in cloudphone-agent .rodata; initiates connection to /register_agent?id=...

flags.documentation_role: Path to the Android DEX/JAR helper library (libsys_core.so / classes.jar)
flags.binary_context: Found in cloudphone-agent .rodata; passed to app_process CLASSPATH invocation

flags.documentation_role: Publicly accessible IPv4/IPv6 address for WebRTC NAT traversal when containerized
flags.binary_context: Exact string 'external-addr' confirmed in .rodata at offset adjacent to 'camera-facing'

flags.documentation_role: Dedicated UDP port allocated for WebRTC RTP media stream (e.g. 50001)
flags.binary_context: Exact string 'webrtc-port' confirmed in .rodata adjacent to 'ice-servers'

flags.documentation_role: Enables superuser/root execution mode on rooted devices without active PC ADB connection
flags.binary_context: Found in cloudphone-agent .rodata alongside CP_AGENT_ROOT environment variable

flags.documentation_role: Camera injection streaming socket address (discovered via binary inspection)
flags.binary_context: Exact string 'camera-addr' located adjacent to 'webrtc-port' and 'camera-size'

flags.documentation_role: Configures camera virtual display frame resolution (e.g. 1920x1080)
flags.binary_context: Exact string 'camera-size' located in .rodata adjacent to 'camera-addr'

flags.documentation_role: Selects front or back camera sensor simulation for virtual injection
flags.binary_context: Exact string 'camera-facing' located in .rodata adjacent to 'external-addr'

flags.documentation_role: Overrides default STUN/TURN server URLs passed from signaling server
flags.binary_context: Exact string 'ice-servers' located in .rodata adjacent to 'webrtc-port'
